summary: Neo comes tumbling down the rattling fire escape and leaps the last ten feet into the alley below, with Agent Brown right behind him. He scrapes himself to his feet, broken and bleeding, and charges for the end of the alley.

what_changes.after: landed in the alley and charging for the end of it
what_changes.evidence: Tumbling down the RATTLING FIRE ESCAPE, Neo leaps the last ten feet into the alley below

what_changes.before: moving and whole enough to flee
what_changes.after: broken and bleeding but back on his feet, charging for the end of the alley
what_changes.evidence: Neo scrapes himself to his feet, broken and bleeding, charging for the end of the alley.

event_hint.one_line: Neo tumbles down the fire escape into an alley with Agent Brown in pursuit and keeps running.
